title: 玩了一夜DeepSeek Harness，我发现它在用《我的世界》的方式干掉Claude Code
content: DeepSeek released Harness v0.1, an open-source, MIT-licensed coding agent framework running locally via browser. Unlike Claude Code's closed system, Harness uses a plugin architecture built on the Cordis microkernel, enabling hot-swappable extensions for models, tools, UI themes, and even sandbox environments. Within 24 hours, the community created 288 plugins, including skins, games, and adapters importing competitors' sessions. The design mirrors Minecraft's moddable foundation—offering a platform rather than a finished product—to eliminate proprietary "harness" premiums and shift competition back to model capabilities and pricing, where DeepSeek holds advantages.

title: 打工人的办公三件套，被 WorkBuddy 用 AI 重做了
content: WorkBuddy is expanding AI-powered office tools beyond traditional Office formats to HTML, smart Markdown, and CSV. Its updated knowledge base enables users to store AI-generated files, collaborate with teammates and AI agents, and reuse content across tasks. Key features include local editing of HTML without coding, publishing webpages with shareable links, and "light apps" that let HTML read from linked CSV data dynamically. Markdown supports AI-native review mode, while CSV files sync across devices and feed into HTML dashboards. The system preserves context for future AI work, positioning these formats as an AI-native alternative to conventional Office documents for individuals and small teams.
